content.short: NFT Marketplace is a base repository for building an NFT marketplace project.
content.description: An open repository from the seventh week of a Web3 learning program, designed to provide starter files you can build on. It gives hands-on exposure to setting up environments for DApps, leveraging IPFS for decentralized storage, and crafting Solidity smart contracts to list NFTs. The project uses MetaMask for authentication and NFT purchases, illustrating a practical workflow for on-chain applications. It serves as a foundation for experimenting with the core components of decentralized apps.
